parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.20.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet address 11.11.11.11/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options static route 11.11.1.explanation: 配置静态路由，将特定目的地址的流量丢弃。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配流量的处理动作，例如discard。

set protocols bgp group EBGP type extern.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP type external

set protocols bgp group EBGP local-as 65.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP local-as 65410

set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.20.1.1 peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.20.1.1 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.explanation: 配置BGP邻居的地址族为IPv4单播。

set protocols bgp group EBGP export adve.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP export advertise-lo0
set protocols bgp group EBGP export adve.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的导出策略。

set policy-options policy-statement adve.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3]/[parameter4] [parameter5]
set policy-options policy-statement adve.command: set policy-options policy-statement advertise-lo0 term 1 from route-filter 11.11.11.11/32 exact
set policy-options policy-statement adve.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件。

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: 路由过滤器的目的地址。

set policy-options policy-statement adve.command: set policy-options policy-statement advertise-lo0 term 1 then accept

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配流量的处理动作，例如accept。
